Campaign.title: Campaign
Campaign.description: Represents a Dungeons & Dragons 5e campaign, which is a series of interconnected sessions played by a group. It encapsulates the overarching narrative and world setting.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Campaign entity.

name.description: The official name of the campaign.

description.description: A detailed overview and synopsis of the campaign's premise, overarching goals, and themes.

settingDetails.description: A comprehensive description of the world setting, including its history, cultures, major geographical features, and relevant lore that defines the campaign's universe.

dateCreated.description: Timestamp indicating when the campaign record was created.

dateLastModified.description: Timestamp indicating when the campaign record was last updated.

Faction.title: Faction
Faction.description: Represents a group or organization within the campaign world with its own distinct goals, motivations, and level of influence.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Faction entity.

campaignId.description: Reference to the Campaign this faction belongs to. (Relationship: Campaign 1:N Faction)

description.description: A detailed description of the faction, including its ideology, goals, methods, resources, and general standing in the world.

alignment.description: The moral and ethical alignment of the faction (e.g., 'Lawful Good', 'Chaotic Evil').

powerLevel.description: Indicates the level of influence or power the faction holds (e.g., 'Local', 'Regional', 'Global').

agendas.description: A list of key hidden or open agendas and objectives that drive the faction's actions.

dateCreated.description: Timestamp indicating when the faction record was created.

dateLastModified.description: Timestamp indicating when the faction record was last updated.

Npc.title: Npc
Npc.description: Represents a Non-Player Character (NPC) crucial to the campaign or specific sessions, providing depth and interaction opportunities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Npc entity.

campaignId.description: Reference to the Campaign this NPC primarily belongs to. (Relationship: Campaign 1:N Npc)

name.description: The full name of the Non-Player Character.

race.description: The race or species of the NPC (e.g., 'Human', 'Elf', 'Dwarf', 'Orc').

dndClass.description: The Dungeons & Dragons 5e class or primary profession of the NPC (e.g., 'Warrior', 'Wizard', 'Merchant', 'Rogue').

description.description: A detailed description of the NPC's physical appearance, personality traits, and notable mannerisms.

backstory.description: A brief summary of the NPC's personal history, significant past events, and key relationships.

alignment.description: The moral and ethical alignment of the NPC (e.g., 'Neutral Good', 'Lawful Evil', 'Chaotic Neutral').

motivations.description: The underlying reasons or desires that drive the NPC's actions and decisions, both overt and subtle.

secrets.description: Any hidden information, truths, vulnerabilities, or past actions that the NPC keeps concealed from others.

tokenImageUrl.description: URL for the NPC's token image in Roll20 or similar platforms.

roll20Macro.description: A Roll20 Roll Template macro that acts as a quick statblock for the NPC.

factionIds.description: References to Faction entities that the NPC is associated with, belongs to, or influences. (Relationship: Npc N:N Faction)

dateCreated.description: Timestamp indicating when the NPC record was created.

dateLastModified.description: Timestamp indicating when the campaign record was last updated.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: Represents a specific place, area, or region within the campaign world that players can visit, interact with, or where events unfold.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Location entity.

campaignId.description: Reference to the Campaign this location belongs to. (Relationship: Campaign 1:N Location)

name.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Waterdeep', 'The Sunken Temple', 'Whispering Woods').

type.description: The type or category of the location (e.g., 'City', 'Town', 'Dungeon', 'Forest', 'Mountain', 'Inn').

description.description: A detailed description of the location, including its appearance, atmosphere, history, and key characteristics.

mapImageUrl.description: URL for the location's tactical or regional map in Roll20.

features.description: A list of prominent features, landmarks, or points of interest within the location.

dominantFactionId.description: Optional reference to the Faction entity that exerts the most control, influence, or ownership over this location. (Relationship: Faction 1:N Location)

dateCreated.description: Timestamp indicating when the location record was created.

dateLastModified.description: Timestamp indicating when the location record was last updated.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: Represents a single game session within a D&D 5e campaign, storing its preparation details, context, and potential outcomes, as requested by the user for 'Preparar Sessão'.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Session entity.

campaignId.description: Reference to the Campaign this session belongs to. (Relationship: Campaign 1:N Session)

title.description: A descriptive title for the game session (e.g., 'The Raid on Serpent's Pass', 'Negotiations at the Iron Summit').

sessionNumber.description: The sequential number of this session within its campaign, useful for ordering.

description.description: A summary of the session's main plot points, significant events that transpired (if played), or the planned agenda and objectives (if prepared).

datePreparedOrPlayed.description: The date when this session was prepared or played.

worldContextSummary.description: A concise summary of the world history, current events, and any critical background information directly relevant to the context of this specific session.

mapDescription.description: A textual description of the primary map or area where the session takes place, detailing key geographical features and points of interest.

mapImageUrl.description: Optional URL to an image file of the map used for the session, linking to Roll20 assets.

involvedFactionIds.description: References to Faction entities that are actively involved, present, or have significant influence in the events of this session. (Relationship: Session N:N Faction)

involvedNpcIds.description: References to Npc entities that are key characters, antagonists, allies, or significant encounters in this session. (Relationship: Session N:N Npc)

involvedLocationIds.description: References to Location entities that are central settings, scenes, or points of action for this session. (Relationship: Session N:N Location)

plotHooks.description: A list of potential adventure hooks, starting points, or inciting incidents designed to engage players in a sandbox style, prompting exploration and decision-making.

activeConflicts.description: A list of major conflicts, tensions, or developing crises that are currently unfolding or are central to the session's narrative.

potentialDevelopments.description: AI-generated suggestions for 3-5 possible future story developments or branching paths based on the session's current context and player actions.

unexpectedComplication.description: AI-generated suggestion for a single unexpected complication, twist, or unforeseen event to introduce into the session.

hiddenHook.description: AI-generated suggestion for a subtle or hidden plot hook, clue, or secret to plant for future discovery by the players.

politicalIntrigueSummary.description: AI-generated summary of political elements, power struggles, factional interests, and potential betrayals relevant to the session's context.

dateCreated.description: Timestamp indicating when the session record was created.

dateLastModified.description: Timestamp indicating when the session record was last updated.
